Protein Food

Oyster

About This Entry

Oyster is briny bivalve — raw on the half shell or grilled. Muscadet, Chablis, and Champagne are classic raw pairings.

Beginner Guide

Eastern oyster is representative; Pacific and European species vary in salinity.

FAQ

What is Oyster?
Eastern oyster is representative; Pacific and European species vary in salinity.
How should Oyster be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
